_about: Public-domain J. R. Macduff (John Ross Macduff, 1818-1895, Church of Scotland, Glasgow) for the Word Hoard: The Mind of Jesus, Memories of Bethany, The Hart and the Water-Brooks and The Cities of Refuge from Project Gutenberg, and 18 more from Internet Archive scans, 1858-1890, among them Memories of Gennesaret, The Prophet of Fire, Memories of Patmos and Gloria Patri. Only books that name him on the title page are shelved; the anonymous ones ('by the author of Morning and Night Watches') wait in alternates. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
